content.description: A worker tells a customer that a delivery is late. They state what is known, distinguish a confirmed update from an estimate, and apologise for their own mistake where responsibility is established. They agree on the next update without making unsupported promises.
flow: Identify the order and explain the known delay.
Give any confirmed information or identify what remains uncertain.
Apologise for an established personal mistake where relevant.
Confirm how the customer will receive the next update.
variationPoints: A known revised time versus no confirmed time.
Whether the worker caused a specific communication error.
A spoken call versus a short written update.
A2 sentence length and support for explaining uncertainty.
